test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
consider the following statements

Statement I: The objective of "Growth with Social Justice & Equality" was introduced in the 10th Five Year Plan.

Statement II: The first Five-Year Plan was based on the "Harrod-Domar model".

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

options.text: Statement I is incorrect, Statement II is correct
Both statements I and II are correct
Both statements I and II are incorrect
Statement I is correct, Statement II is incorrect

solution:
The correct answer is __**Statement I is incorrect, Statement II is correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Statement I:** The objective of "Growth with Social Justice & Equality" was introduced in the 9th Five-Year Plan (1997-2002), not the 10th Five-Year Plan. Hence, Statement I is incorrect.
 
• **Statement II:** The first Five-Year Plan (1951-56) was indeed based on the Harrod-Domar growth model, which focuses on the relationship between savings, investment, and economic growth. Hence, Statement II is correct.
 
• The 10th Five-Year Plan (2002-2007) aimed at achieving 8% GDP growth rate and reducing poverty by 5 percentage points by 2007.
 
• The Harrod-Domar model, used in the first plan, emphasized the need for investment to spur economic growth, particularly in a newly independent economy like India.
 
• Therefore, the correct interpretation is that Statement I is incorrect and Statement II is correct.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans:** India's Five-Year Plans were centralized economic and social growth strategies modeled after Soviet planning, implemented from 1951 until 2017 when they were discontinued.
 
• **Harrod-Domar Growth Model:** A Keynesian economic model that stresses the importance of savings and investment for growth. It assumes constant returns to scale and no diminishing returns in capital.
 
• **9th Five-Year Plan:** Introduced the theme of "Growth with Social Justice & Equality," focusing on poverty alleviation and employment generation.
 
• **10th Five-Year Plan:** Aimed to achieve an annual GDP growth rate of 8% and emphasized reducing regional disparities in economic growth.
 
• **End of Five-Year Plans:** The NITI Aayog replaced the Planning Commission in 2015, marking a shift from fixed-term planning to a more flexible, goal-oriented approach under the "Vision, Strategy, and Action Agenda" framework.
